My Interests

I am interested in how internal representations form, stabilize, and change over time. Specifically:

What happens to existing representations when a system incorporates new information? What distinguishes transient perturbations from "meaningful" representational change? Under what conditions does that change result in structural reorganization? And more importantly, how can these processes be formalized mathematically?

I approach these questions through mathematical modeling and computational experiments, focusing on dynamical systems, associative memory, and learning dynamics.

Memory becomes a natural domain when studying these processes because it requires systems to preserve, modify, and reconstruct existing representations in response to new information. Broadly speaking, I am interested in whether mathematical principles can help describe representational change across systems.
